title: Group Policy to Intune Settings Migration
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (project/migration: inventory and translate AD GPOs to Intune, manage coexistence/precedence during cutover, risk of conflicting policy).
hook: Move your Group Policy estate into Intune — translated, not guessed, with a safe cutover
problem: Decades of Group Policy settings keep your domain-joined PCs in line — but they only apply on the corporate network, they don't follow cloud-joined and remote devices, and nobody fully knows what's in there anymore. This solution gives you a structured migration from Active Directory GPOs to Intune: inventory what you actually have, translate settings to the Intune settings catalog and ADMX-backed policies, manage coexistence so on-prem and cloud policy don't fight, and cut over by rings — without losing a setting that mattered.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — how GPO and Intune policy differ, the settings catalog and imported ADMX model, the Group Policy analytics workflow, coexistence and precedence during migration, and the ring-based cutover.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, access to export GPOs, Group Policy analytics, target device groups, a rollback plan) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: export and inventory GPOs, run Group Policy analytics, map supported settings to settings-catalog/ADMX policies, handle unsupported settings, configure coexistence and precedence, assign in rings, then validate parity and expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — GPO export/inventory discovery, settings-parity validation (GPO vs. Intune), a migration coverage and gap report, safe remediation of conflicts, and a migration-ring group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A structured migration from Active Directory Group Policy to Intune — inventory, translate to the settings catalog and ADMX policies, manage coexistence, and cut over by rings without losing settings that matter. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: A structured migration from Active Directory Group Policy to Intune — inventory, translate to the settings catalog and ADMX, manage coexistence, cut over by rings.

bottom_line: Your Group Policy estate translated into Intune — settings that matter preserved, coexistence managed during the move, and a ringed cutover that follows devices on or off the corporate network — proven on a pilot before you scale.
